name: Autumn Falls
description: A small Vermont town where three generations of a family gather for a wedding that will change everything.
seed_prompt: A family drama set during a pivotal weekend where old wounds surface and new bonds form.
lore_content:
Autumn Falls, Vermont. Population 3,200. The kind of place where everyone knows your business but pretends they don't. The Callahan family has lived here for five generations, and this weekend, they're all coming home for a wedding.

Eleanor Callahan, 78, is the family matriarch. Sharp-tongued and sharper-minded, she's kept this family together through sheer force of will. She's hiding a diagnosis she hasn't shared with anyone. This might be the last time she sees all her children in one place.

Michael Callahan, 52, is Eleanor's eldest. A successful Boston lawyer, he hasn't spoken to his brother David in fifteen years over their father's will. His wife Patricia thinks this trip is a mistake. His daughter Emma, the bride, just wants one weekend without drama.

David Callahan, 48, stayed in Autumn Falls to run the family hardware store. He's quietly bitter about being the one who stayed while Michael got the glory. His wife Sarah knows he's been drinking again. Their son Jake, 19, is thinking about dropping out of college.

Margaret 'Maggie' Callahan, 45, is the youngest sibling. A free spirit who left for California at 18 and never looked back. She's returning with her partner Alex, whom the family has never met. She's also three months pregnant and hasn't told anyone.

Emma Callahan, 26, is getting married to Ryan Torres, a kind man from a working-class family. She loves him, but part of her wonders if she's settling. Her college ex, James, just RSVP'd yes to the wedding.

Ryan Torres, 28, knows the Callahans think he's not good enough for Emma. He's determined to prove himself, but the prenup Michael insisted on still stings.

Reverend Thomas Chen has known this family for thirty years. He's seen their best and worst. He's also the only person who knows Eleanor's secret, bound by a confession she made last month.

Over one weekend, secrets will surface, old wounds will reopen, and this family will either heal or shatter.
